ns2:course.label: British Imperialism
ns2:course.description: Thematic approach to Britain's role as an imperial power, its impact on global issues and affairs, and the effect of colonies and colonial peoples on the history of its development as a Western "nation." 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college history.
